results.title: After Tulsi, enter the Apsara: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 to be replaced by new supernatural show; cast, storyline & more
results.description: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi 2 ending soon? No release date is out yet, though reports suggest a premiere of the new show 'Apsara' by the end of October.

results.title: The Expanse Returns: New RPG Opens 2027 Window for Fans
results.description: Owlcat Games' third‑person action RPG Osiris Reborn will launch in spring 2027, offering an original story set amid the early events of The Expanse, letting players assume new crew members and explore familiar locations while maintaining the series' core conflict between Earth, Mars and the Belt.
